aboutGame.title: What is Active Matter?
paragraphs: Active Matter is a realistic tactical extraction shooter set in a multiverse fractured by quantum instability. Operating as a contracted mercenary, you infiltrate hazardous anomaly zones governed by shifting physical laws, gravity anomalies, and hostile syndicate operatives to harvest precious quantum materials.

Survive ruthless PvPvE skirmishes, master lethal ballistic weaponry, scavenge high-tier technology, and secure your extraction before spacetime ruptures consume the sector. Our wiki provides up-to-date weapon stats, zone maps, equipment blueprints, and tactical raid walkthroughs.

modules.name: activematter.blog System Requirements
modules.description: This module provides minimum and recommended hardware requirements, supported platforms, and technical information. It helps players check whether their devices can run the game smoothly.

highlights.label: OS
highlights.detail: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit modern operating system required)

highlights.label: CPU
highlights.detail: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 (Recommended: i7-10700 / Ryzen 7 3700X)

highlights.label: RAM
highlights.detail: 16 GB RAM minimum for stable Unreal Engine 5 performance and large map caching

highlights.label: GPU
highlights.detail: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) minimum; RTX 3060 / Radeon RX 6700 XT recommended

highlights.label: DirectX
highlights.detail: Version 12 with DirectX Raytracing (DXR) support recommended

highlights.label: Storage
highlights.detail: 70 GB available space on high-speed Solid State Drive (SSD strongly recommended)

items.question: What is activematter.blog Wiki?
items.answer: activematter.blog is an independent community wiki covering Active Matter, the futuristic tactical extraction shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. We provide weapon statistics, raid guides, anomaly mechanics, and loadout strategies.

items.question: What core gameplay features does activematter.blog cover for Active Matter?
items.answer: activematter.blog covers tactical PvPvE combat, quantum extraction loops, syndicate factions, weapons customization, and survival mechanics in anomaly zones.

items.question: How can beginners improve their survival rate using activematter.blog guides?
items.answer: New players can follow the beginner guides on activematter.blog to learn safe zone navigation, quantum particle harvesting, and secure extraction point tactics.

items.question: Are weapon stats and gear rankings regularly updated on activematter.blog?
items.answer: Yes, activematter.blog updates firearm performance, attachment tiers, and armor ratings alongside official playtest patches and balance updates.

items.question: Where can players find system requirements and release details on activematter.blog?
items.answer: Visit the system and release sections on activematter.blog for complete PC hardware benchmarks, beta playtest schedules, and platform launch information.
